name: Token Burner
description: Provably burn CashTokens. Send tokens to the shared TokenBurner address, then anyone can destroy them in a transaction whose only output is an OP_RETURN farewell message. Burns are final; the satoshis sent with the tokens go to miners.

depositor.name: Depositor
depositor.description: Sends tokens to the burner address so they can be destroyed.

burner.name: Burner
burner.description: Anyone who destroys the tokens waiting at the burner address. The burner cannot keep anything.

depositFungibleTokens.name: Send fungible tokens to the burner
depositFungibleTokens.description: Send $(<tokenAmount>) tokens of category $(<tokenCategory>) to the burner address. Anyone can then burn them, and nobody can get them back.

depositor.name: Send tokens to the burner
depositor.description: Choose the token category and amount, and the satoshis that travel with them (they become the burn fee).

depositNonfungibleToken.name: Send an NFT to the burner
depositNonfungibleToken.description: Send one NFT of category $(<tokenCategory>) to the burner address. Anyone can then burn it, and nobody can get it back.

depositor.name: Send an NFT to the burner
depositor.description: Choose the NFT (category, capability, commitment) and the satoshis that travel with it (they become the burn fee).

depositSatoshis.name: Send BCH to the burner (a gift to miners)
depositSatoshis.description: Send $(<depositSatoshis>) satoshis to the burner address. This is not a burn of the BCH: whoever burns the coin next spends it into an OP_RETURN carrying 0 satoshis, so the whole amount becomes the transaction fee and goes to the miner.

depositor.name: Send BCH to the burner
depositor.description: Choose how many satoshis to send. They will go to a miner as a fee when the burner is next swept.

burn.name: Burn
burn.description: Destroy the tokens in burner coins. The transaction has exactly one output, an OP_RETURN with your farewell message (up to 220 bytes), so the tokens are gone for good and the coins’ satoshis go to miners. Your wallet can only see burner coins after it has sent something to the burner address itself.

burner.name: Burn
burner.description: Pick one or more burner coins and write a farewell message (it can be empty).

depositFungibleTransaction.name: Tokens sent to the burner
depositFungibleTransaction.description: $(<tokenAmount>) tokens of category $(<tokenCategory>) were sent to the burner.

depositNonfungibleTransaction.name: NFT sent to the burner
depositNonfungibleTransaction.description: An NFT of category $(<tokenCategory>) was sent to the burner.

depositSatoshisTransaction.name: BCH sent to the burner
depositSatoshisTransaction.description: $(<depositSatoshis>) satoshis were sent to the burner; they go to a miner when the burner is next swept.

burnTransaction.name: Tokens burned
burnTransaction.description: Tokens were burned with the farewell message: $(<burnMessage>)

burnerInput.name: Burner coin
burnerInput.description: A coin at the burner address. Its tokens are destroyed and its satoshis go to miners.

burnerFungibleOutput.name: Tokens awaiting burn
burnerFungibleOutput.description: $(<tokenAmount>) tokens of category $(<tokenCategory>) at the burner address.

burnerSatoshisOutput.name: BCH awaiting the next burn
burnerSatoshisOutput.description: $(<depositSatoshis>) satoshis at the burner address, a gift to whichever miner mines the next burn.

burnerNonfungibleOutput.name: NFT awaiting burn
burnerNonfungibleOutput.description: An NFT of category $(<tokenCategory>) at the burner address.

farewellOutput.name: Farewell message
farewellOutput.description: The OP_RETURN that marks the burn: $(<burnMessage>)

burnerLockingScript.name: TokenBurner
burnerLockingScript.description: The shared TokenBurner address. Anything sent here can only ever be burned.

farewellLockingScript.name: Farewell message
farewellLockingScript.description: An OP_RETURN carrying the farewell message. It holds no value and can never be spent.

scripts.burnerBytecode: OP_TXOUTPUTCOUNT OP_1 OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY OP_0 OP_OUTPUTTOKENCATEGORY OP_0 OP_EQUALVERIFY <0x6a> OP_0 OP_OUTPUTBYTECODE OP_1 OP_SPLIT OP_DROP OP_EQUAL

tokenCategory.name: Token category
tokenCategory.description: The 32-byte category ID of the tokens to burn, as hex.

tokenAmount.name: Token amount
tokenAmount.description: How many fungible tokens to burn.

tokenCapability.name: NFT capability
tokenCapability.description: The capability of the NFT to burn: none, mutable or minting.

tokenCommitment.name: NFT commitment
tokenCommitment.description: The commitment of the NFT to burn, as hex (empty for none).

depositSatoshis.name: Satoshis with the tokens
depositSatoshis.description: Satoshis sent to the burner address, alone or with tokens (a token output needs about 1000). They become the fee of the next burn and go to a miner; they are not destroyed.

burnMessage.name: Farewell message
burnMessage.description: Text written into the burn’s OP_RETURN, up to 220 bytes. It can be empty.
